command: ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIALS=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d'); "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 1; PID=$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof link.localclimate.app | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" forward --remove tcp:9222 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" forward tcp:9222 localabstract:webview_devtools_remote_$PID >/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert len(d)==1; print(d[0]["title"], d[0]["url"], d[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'
